replacements.promotion-a-balanced-knight-fork: Replaces the old queen-deficit fork with roughly balanced forces. The Bishop on e1 blocks the rook from answering Qg1#, so the back-rank danger is real; checking Knight promotion wins the Queen rather than merely recovering a large deficit.
replacements.promotion-a-balanced-rook-clearance: Replaces the already-a-Bishop-ahead clearance. The added opposing Knight actively attacks c7 and defends the rook after Rxc7, removing the routine winning recapture available in the old version. Initial balance approximately one pawn.
replacements.promotion-a-rook-exchange-promotion: Equal rooks plus one pawn. Immediate promotion loses to Rxc8. Rb8+ forces a choice: exchange rooks and allow capture-promotion, or move the King and lose the rook to Rxa8. The pawn recapture makes the rook offer safe.
replacements.promotion-a-capture-blocker-exchange: Roughly balanced rook and pawn versus rook and knight. Two valid capture orders in ONE exercise: rook takes the blocker then pawn promotes, or pawn capture-promotes then rook recaptures. Declining the exchange loses the other rook; the complete payoff, not just the first knight capture, is required.
replacements.promotion-a-master-94f8f46e8e703025: Rxf1+ — Xe từ b1 bắt Xe ở f1 và chiếu. Sau Kxf1, a1=Q+ phong cấp có chiếu. Đổi Xe ngang giá loại quân có thể bắt Tốt khi phong cấp; cần tính nước bắt lại của Vua.
replacements.promotion-a-master-d80d26ca5ca1d728: f2+ — Tốt từ f3 đến f2 và chiếu. Nước chiếu ngăn Trắng kịp phong cấp Tốt h7. Sau nước Vua đáp, f1=Q+ phong cấp và mở đường chiếu của Xe g2. Kể cả khi Vua trắng bắt Mã e3, Đen vẫn tăng lợi thế vật chất.
replacements.promotion-a-master-ee62b9c3648c98a2: Near-equal material: checking pawn advance enables capture-promotion of a rook; recapturing the promoted queen still concedes the exchange. Distinct from the straight promotion/discovered-check game: the captured last-rank rook is the material target.
replacements.promotion-a-master-3758bfad170039f0: A rook check evicts the opposing king physically blocking the promotion square. The pawn protects the checking rook, and the rook then protects the new queen. Direct promotion is illegal because e1 is occupied. This is king eviction, distinct from moving the solver own rook off its own promotion square.
replacements.promotion-a-master-b26391c1f9174baa: A protected knight interposes on the rook’s line to the promotion square. Rxb1 is answered by axb1=Q+, while refusing the exchange permits a1=Q. This is quiet interference, distinct from moving a blocking rook away or checking to exchange rooks.
replacements.promotion-a-master-bd38e1825a7c2cf0: Rook relocation simultaneously escapes the attacking king and screens the king/new-queen file against a checking rook skewer. Direct f8=Q+ permits Kxd4 and requires further queen tactics; Rf4 secures the short payoff. Distinct from clearing the promotion square: neither d4 nor f4 is the promotion square.
replacements.promotion-a-master-1feb26cc76391e36: King approach protects the promotion square while maintaining protection of the pawn and the tempo against an opposing passed pawn. Immediate promotion is captured. Distinct from the old rejected king-clearance endpoint: the king is not blocking the pawn, and choosing the wrong king move loses the race.
replacements.promotion-a-capture-minor-avoid-pat: Rough starting balance: two pawns against a rook (-300). The checking rook on c8 must be captured by the pawn; queen and rook promotion stalemate the opposing king, while bishop/knight capture-promotion leave legal king moves and a material edge. Different from the existing noncapture rook anti-pat task; the captured checker and choice of minor piece are essential.

exercise.solution: 78...Rxb7+ — Xe từ g7 bắt Xe b7 và chiếu. Trong ván đấu, 79.Kxb7 đưa Vua trắng lên b7, ngay trước Tốt b5; 79...f2 80.b6 f1=Q. Ván đấu kết thúc sau nước phong cấp. The certified tree covers every legal King reply to the check, every reply to ...f2, and every legal reply after promotion. This is a rook exchange, not a sacrifice, and teaches a different decision from offering an exchange on the passer file: remove the opponent rook by check before beginning the pawn race.

exercise.solution: 44.Rh8+! — Xe từ b8 đến h8 chiếu và được đặt làm mồi thí quân. Nếu 44...Kxh8, 45.e8=Q+ Kh7, Trắng đã đổi Xe lấy Tốt phong cấp thành Hậu và giành lợi thế vật chất; các nước đáp khác sau nước chiếu và sau khi phong Hậu cũng được kiểm tra. advancedAdditions.decision: White is materially down and the black Rook on c6 attacks the promotion square e8. Direct 44.e8=Q? loses to ...Rc1#, and the 600,000-node all-legal-root screen found 44.Rh8+! as the only move retaining the winning advantage. The Rook is offered with check: if ...Kxh8, e8=Q+ wins material; if the King declines, the pawn promotes with check. The all-reply material certificate includes every legal response to the check, the promoted Queen, and the opponent’s reply. The game ended after the actual 44...Kg6 45.e8=Q+; the Kxh8 branch is verified analysis, not game continuation. This is a genuine two-move-side sacrifice and fits C despite its favorable starting engine evaluation: that evaluation comes from the promotion tactic, while every other legal first move loses, including immediate promotion.

exercise.solution: 34.Qe8+! — Hậu từ e6 đến e8 chiếu Vua f8 và đặt Hậu cho Xe d8 bắt. Nếu 34...Rxe8, 35.fxe8=Q+ bắt Xe và phong cấp; sau 35...Kg7, Trắng hơn vật chất. advancedAdditions.decision: The starting material is approximately balanced (White is down 80 centipawns by project piece values). 34.Qe8+ is the top move in the 600,000-node-per-legal-root screen; all other roots score substantially lower, including immediate pawn promotion, and no immediate mate is available. This is a real Queen offer and capture-promotion, distinct from the current C rook sacrifices that clear a file or draw a Rook away. The source game ended after 34.Qe8+; all continuations after it are verified analysis, not played game moves.

Nếu Trắng tránh đổi, Đen bắt Tượng chắn bằng ...Bxa1 hoặc ...Kxb2, tùy nước đáp. Cả hai cách đều giữ được lợi thế vật chất; nhánh mẫu là diễn biến thực tế của ván đấu.

advancedAdditions.decision: Distinct B mechanism: the White Bishop controls a1, so promoting immediately allows Bxa1. Kxc3 captures that sole defender without a sacrifice; after any legal White reply, the a-pawn promotes safely and the resulting material gain is preserved. This differs from exchanging a defender with a minor piece or opening a promotion file by a pawn recapture. The initial material deficit is essential context: engine review shows every alternative root loses, while Kxc3 is the only root that turns the promotion into a winning material advantage.
